title: ApplyOps
description: INPUT of `dmtool -m <model> apply <ops.json>` (CLI-SPEC §7) — an ORDERED array of op-records applied to ONE model in a single session: one read → ordered surgery → one terminal kernel gate → one write, with atomic rollback (a mid-sequence failure writes nothing). Each op-record is {target, op, …args}; the per-op fields are that verb's params — discover them from `manifest` + `schema <target> <op>`. Distinct from `batch` (which takes {verb, args} for stateless per-op dispatch). Each op emits a per-op result envelope (a successful edit is `staged` until the terminal gate commits the whole sequence); the wrapper is {ops, committed, failedAt, written, results[]}.

target.description: the element family acted on: field | group | rule | … (see `manifest`)

op.description: the operation: add | modify | remove | … (valid for the target)
